verdict.rationale: Seller-facing statements and reconciliation reports are a fair question for a marketplace payments platform like Mangopay, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, or bookkeeping exports. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: custom bank-statement descriptor text, wallets, webhooks, and a pre-built bank-account registration component.

support.subject: As an ops user, sellers can self-serve their money questions — per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, and exports that let their bookkeeper close the month without contacting me
